blockers.blocker: Live execution proof for open USB descriptor code
blockers.next_test: Run the guarded marker stage when the printer is connected and power-cycled.
blockers.why: Without the marker descriptor appearing on the host, we do not yet know that custom code can control USB responses after upload.

blockers.next_test: If marker fails, use the interrupt-lane model to build a more explicit completion polling probe.
blockers.why: Stock firmware uses event flags at 0x10021318 fed by the USB interrupt task. The marker draft now waits for setup gates to clear and returns to polling, but hardware has not proved this replaces the stock event wait.

blockers.next_test: Do not test this until USB-only open code is proven; continue static mapping of video/engine semantics first.
blockers.why: The mapped print model reaches raster handoff, but real printing needs synchronized video transfer and mechanical engine control.

blockers.blocker: Video sideband values for the first print path
blockers.next_test: After USB-only execution is proven, use a non-printing or tightly gated trace/probe to distinguish whether stock leaves +0x26 zero or seeds it from page height/runtime state.
blockers.why: Static analysis now shows +0x26 is critical for channel-B refill/final accounting, but its active-work source is still not proven.

components.replacement_need: open firmware must implement a bulk OUT receiver/read-callback shim that feeds the parser state machine
